results.name: Conti Ransomware Strikes Delta Electronics Resulting in Encryption of 1,500 Servers and 12,000 Computers
results.description:
Delta Electronics, a Taiwanese electronics company and a provider for Apple, Tesla, HP, and Dell fell victim to a cyberattack today. The company said the incident impacted only non-critical systems, which had no significant impact on its operations. AdvIntel "Andariel" platform detected the attack on 18 January 2022.

Action taken by Delta
Delta is now working on restoring systems taken down during the attack. It has hired the services of third-party security experts to help with the investigation and recovery process. The electronics provider has also notified government law enforcement agencies to assist with the follow-up investigation.

results.name: Andariel APT Spreading TigerRat and TigerDownloader Via Phishing
results.description: Andariel group is a state-sponsored threat actor. It is a subgroup of the Lazarus cybercrime group, considered one of the most sophisticated North Korean threat actors to which threat researchers have attributed many attacks from 2009 to 2021. The Andariel group is mostly targeting South Korean entities focusing mainly on financial gain and cyber espionage. This group has been using both spearphishing and compromised websites, along with a custom downloader (TigerDownloader) and remote access trojan (TigerRAT) as their initial attack vector in recent financial and cyberespionage campaigns. TigerRat were distribute through spearphishing attachment and compromised website that will execute the malicious code after execution.  Coverage is in place for Symantec's email security products. TigerDownloader were being use to download the TigerRat. It then will communicate with C&C for further malicious command.

results.name: Andariel evolves to target South Korea with ransomware
results.description: The threat actor has been spreading the third stage payload from the middle of 2020 onwards and leveraged malicious Word documents and files mimicking PDF documents as infection vectors. Notably, in addition to the final backdoor, SecureList discovered one victim getting infected with custom ransomware. It adds another facet to this Andariel campaign, which also sought financial profit in a previous operation involving the compromise of ATMs.

results.name: Andariel – New North Korean Threat Actor Group Profiled
results.description: A South Korean financial security organization, the Financial Security Institute (FSI), assembled a profile of a previously little-known North Korean threat actor group called Andariel in July 2017. Andariel is a sub-groups of the Lazarus Group (also known as HIDDEN COBRA) and primarily targets South Korean government and commercial entities.

results.name: New Andariel Reconnaissance Tactics Hint At Next Targets
results.description: Reconnaissance plays a vital role in criminal operations, and some groups go to great lengths to investigate their targets’ systems. A recent example is the Andariel Group, a known branch of the notorious Lazarus Group. Last month we tracked new scouting techniques coming from Andariel, which were used mainly against South Korean targets.
